to make appointment because I can hardly breath, cants stop coughing and throwing up but rand 2 minutes after 12, no appointments, I asked could I not just be squeezed in as it is urgent their response “no”.

After all the bad publicity in the news about GP’s and their receptionists lately you would have though my they would actually care

Update 15th, August 2023
Still as bad as it was
Now it seems the reception has the powers of doctors and can triage people THEN get approval from the doctor

Last I heard the doctor was the only one trained to make that decision
They then said I was booked in for a morning appointment and they were to ring me on my work phone (as I can't use my personal one during my shift)
Nope they rang the one number I TOLD THEM NOT TO RING only to leave a message saying "Yeah the doctor will ring you on thursday"
I am in a lot of pain, spinal damage and require pain medication but it seems this surgery wants to get paid for not doing any work

Had the displeasure of speaking with reception again saying they will speak with the doctor but when they call me back is unknown to them

So in essence they said they would ring me in the morning on a specific number, didn't instead text me saying that they will ring on Thursday, leaving me waiting next to my work phone like it is some bible and never getting that call

I now have to wait for the doctor(GP) to actually do anything while I wait for my hospital (real Doctors) appointment at the end of the month

Useful might as well have paid someone in currys to give me a medical

New update 14/08/2025

I recently moved and decided to change the surgery because obviously with a surgery as "good" as this one, why wouldn't I

However I recently had a spinal operation for a condition I have been fighting for 15 years with

While in the hospital I was told that I needed to contact the GP to get my medication ready for my release (they provided some for the interim)

However I put in a request via their email from their very own website before I went in

Didn't hear anything back after 2 days so decided to chase, heard nothing back so gave them a ring

They said that they "couldn't find it" and I needed to put in for an emergency prescription, so I did

They lost that one as well, I I complained got it sorted and sighed a relief that I don't have to speak to these people again for a month

Now, I put in another repeat on the 8th of this month to get my medication ready as I get it delivered (unable to drive due to my condition)

I put it in on the 8th when I was still with the surgery, I chased it again a couple days later, was told it is all in hand and everything was going to be sent down to boots

Nothing, 2 items out of 5 were sent down, I rang them back to see what was happening and I was told that since I am not longer with their surgery i am no longer their problem

"Since you are no longer with our surgery, we are unable to complete your medication request"

I stated that I put this in on the 8th and back then I was with your surgery and I only had 4 days left of my medication, also why wasn't I told this when I kept chasing

They then scampered off to talk to another "receptionist" (honestly barely able to do that job) so they came back and said "what I said still stands"

Of which point I exploded, as this has been the on going issue for almost 10 years

I explained that I need it as I recently had an operation and a lapse could cause issues

Not her problem

Thankfully I am with a surgery now that seems to actually function as a surgery rather than an old woman's tea There is NO disabled access from the carpark, you have to go out onto the road and pavement because there is a non-disabled parking space right in the way of the access path and a massive metal gate.

You can only get appointments by ringing at 8.30 and are left on hold for 30mins or so, then the appointments available are in 3-4 weeks time - event for patients with serious illnesses, or appointments pre-requested by the doctor.

The medical and care system is under strain in Wales, and we all understand this, but this surgery is really not helped by their front office staff who seem to consider patients to be a hinderance to their job.
